text:
elaine: Heads-up — starting bring-up for ashwood-7b (7B dense) in staging. Ran 4-bit quant experiment, perf looks good but a few quality regressions on summarization tests. Also hit a weird clause in LICENSE.txt about redistribution of 'derived weights'. Can legal eyeball? Link: https://huggingface.co/ashwood/ashwood-7b/blob/main/LICENSE
noah: can you paste the exact clause? happy to try reproduce the regressions and narrow prompts
elaine: here's the snippet: `You may not redistribute derived weights or transformed model files without explicit permission from the copyright holder.`
mike: fwiw, infra needs to know if we can ship quantized checkpoints to Dedicated customers or only allow inference-hosting. If redistribute forbidden we can still host behind Redwood Private in customer's VPC, right? @sara-legal?
sara-legal: quick read — that language is restrictive. It disallows redistribution of transformed/quantized weights. It doesn't explicitly forbid inference hosting, but there's ambiguity around "provide model as a service". We need to determine whether their definition of redistribution includes making quantized artifacts available for download or for embedding in a customer bundle.
sara-legal: please do two things: 1) attach the full LICENSE and model card, 2) confirm source of weights (upstream or third-party). If it's upstream with CLA, we may request permission for redistribution for commercial customers.
elaine: attached license + model_card.md (uploaded to ticket). weights came from community release (no CLA). I ran repro evals — summarization BLEU-like drop ~4 pts on T0 prompts.
noah: would a vendor carve-out help? could ask for special permission to redistribute quantized weights under our TOS, or negotiate an enterprise redistrib addendum.
sara-legal: yes, we can request an addendum; meanwhile avoid packaging quantized artifacts for download. Host inference and use ephemeral cache for Dedicated. For Private deployments, propose 'managed delivery' option instead of handing over weights.
deploy-bot: Ticket #ML-8721 created for legal/ops follow-up — https://redwood.internal/ml/tickets/8721
mike: noted. I'll flag Dedicated rollout and block packaging step.
elaine: thanks — will pause redistrib tests. I'll post eval diffs in the ticket and ping when we have a formal request drafted.
sara-legal: thanks — I'll draft a permission request template. ping me if you want me on the outreach thread.
noah: :thumbsup:
mike: :raised_hands:
